exposure: positive intrapartum ultrasound breech engagement sign (+ IPUBES)
outcome: Rate of manual assistance in vaginal deliveries
cohort: 106 mothers with vaginally intended breech delivery
finding: Women with positive intrapartum ultrasound breech engagement sign (+ IPUBES) had a significantly lower rate of cesarean section compared to those with negative IPUBES.
mod_finding: Women with a positive intrapartum ultrasound breech engagement sign (+IPUBES) had a significantly lower rate of cesarean section compared to those with a negative IPUBES.
